sources.title: llama.cpp · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: llama.cpp supports multiple endpoints like /tokenize, /health, /embedding, and many more. For a comprehensive list of available endpoints, please refer to the API documentation. Deployment Steps To deploy an endpoint with a llama.cpp container, follow these steps: Create a new endpoint and select a repository containing a GGUF model.

sources.title: ggml-org/llama.cpp | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document provides a high-level introduction to the llama.cpp project, its purpose as a high-performance LLM inference library, supported model architectures, key features, and implementation insights. It serves as a foundational reference for understanding how the system is structured, its main components, and the data flow during inference.

sources.title: Model Pipeline | ggml-org/llama.cpp | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The model pipeline transforms models through several stages: acquisition, conversion, optional quantization, and deployment. Each stage prepares the model for efficient inference while maintaining compatibility with llama.cpp's runtime.
